name: Utakata
source:
Main character loses his sibling and memory in an accident. He drives housekeepers crazy. But this 47th housekeeper is a man who is not afraid of difficulties.

This is a bundle featuring three games ''Tegami'', ''Itsuka Wasurete'' and "Isshou, Hanashite Nanka Yaranai".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在事故中失去兄弟和记忆，逼得家政人员苦不堪言。然而，第47任家政是一名不畏困难的男人。

本作收录三部游戏：《Tegami》《ItsukaWasurete》和《Isshou,HanashiteNankaYaranai》。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
